===Etymology 1=== From [[w:Middle English|Middle English]][[Category:English terms inherited from Middle English|AH]][[Category:English terms derived from Middle English|AH]] [[:ah#Middle_English|ah]], [[:aa#Middle_English|aa]], [[:a/languages M to Z#Middle_English|a]] (“ah”), of imitative origin[[Category:English onomatopoeias|AH]], or from [[w:Old English|Old English]][[Category:English terms inherited from Old English|AH]][[Category:English terms derived from Old English|AH]] [[:ea#Old_English|ēa]], [[:Reconstruction:Old English/eah|*eah]] (“oh, alas”), from [[w:Proto-West Germanic language|Proto-West Germanic]][[Category:English terms inherited from Proto-West Germanic|AH]][[Category:English terms derived from Proto-West Germanic|AH]] [[:Reconstruction:Proto-West Germanic/a|*a]], [[:Reconstruction:Proto-West Germanic/ah|*ah]] (“ah”). Earliest recorded use is circa 1175 in the ''[[Ormulum]]'': ''A, Maȝȝstre! icc wat tatt tu full wiss Arrt Godess Sune'' ("Ah, Master! I know for sure that thou art God's Son"). Some propose that the Middle English is borrowed from [[w:Old French|Old French]][[Category:English terms derived from Old French|AH]] [[:a/languages M to Z#Old_French|a]] (“ah!, oh!, hey!”) (represented by modern [[w:French language|French]] [[:ah#French|ah]]).{{R:Lexico}}{{R:Online_Etymology_Dictionary}} Compare also [[w:West Frisian language|West Frisian]] [[:a/languages M to Z#West_Frisian|a]], [[:ah#West_Frisian|ah]] (“ah”), [[w:Dutch language|Dutch]] [[:a/languages A to L#Dutch|a]], [[:ah#Dutch|ah]] (“ah”), [[w:Middle Low German|Middle Low German]] [[:a/languages M to Z#Middle_Low_German|a]] (“ah”), [[w:Old High German|Old High German]] [[:a/languages M to Z#Old_High_German|a]], [[:aa#Old_High_German|aa]], [[:ah#Old_High_German|ah]] (“ah, oh”) (whence modern [[w:German language|German]] [[:ah#German|ah]]), [[w:Faroese language|Faroese]] [[:áh#Faroese|áh]] (“oh, ah, alas”), [[w:Icelandic language|Icelandic]] [[:æ#Icelandic|æ]], [[:ai#Icelandic|ai]] (“ah, oh”), [[w:Latin|Latin]] [[:ah#Latin|ah]] (“ah”). ====Pronunciation==== * [[Wiktionary:International Phonetic Alphabet|IPA]]([[Appendix:English pronunciation|key]]): /ɑː/, /aː/[[Category:English 1-syllable words|AH]][[Category:English 1-syllable words|AH]][[Category:English terms with IPA pronunciation|AH]] *
